headline: Google has added a Map tool to its Gemini phone app that lets people choose an area on a live map and ask Gemini about it.
score_reason: Pool score kept: a small interface feature, widely rolled out, with no wider effect reported.
importance_line: Gemini users on Android and iPhone get an easier way to ask questions tied to a place; it is a small feature, and the '@' change was only seen in an early test version of the app and is not yet widely available.
summary: 9to5Google reports that the Gemini app on Android and iPhone now has a Map tool, already widely rolled out, which shows a live map where users choose an area and add it to their question; it is not on the web version. The site also saw an early test version of the Google app in which the '/' key used to call up skills, Gemini's add-on abilities, is replaced by '@', a change that is not yet widely available.
notes: Skills replace Gems announcement was 30 Sep 2026 per the article; not treated as today's event.
